summary: This document defines ways to identify a digital object using the output of a hash function. It specifies a new URI scheme, a way to map such names to HTTP URLs, and binary and human-speakable formats. The names can link strongly to the content, so the object can be checked against its reference.

eli5.summary: Instead of naming a file by where it lives, you name it by its fingerprint. If the fingerprint matches, you know you got the right thing.

questions: how to name things with hashes
